title: Book Description:
paragraphs: Have you ever prayed and felt like heaven was quiet?
Many believers experience seasons where God seems distant and prayers feel unanswered.

In When God Feels Silent, discover how Scripture reveals that divine silence is not abandonment but often preparation. Through biblical stories, spiritual insight, and honest encouragement, this book helps readers strengthen their faith during seasons of waiting.
If you are struggling with doubt, spiritual dryness, or unanswered prayer, this book will help you learn how to trust God even in the silence.

• spiritual warfare
• repentance and freedom
• identity in Christ
• faith during difficult seasons
